response.rationale: This is an electronics item delivered 33 days ago. The highest-priority applicable rule is RET-003 (priority 20), which makes electronics returns ineligible after 15 days. Higher-priority rules do not apply: RET-012 requires final_sale (false), RET-020 requires defective (false), and RET-050/RET-051 require goodwill_grant/fraud_hold (both false). Loyalty status is not a factor.
